name: vault-brain
description: A fast, local-first encrypted Markdown knowledge engine with controlled AI access, backlinks, history, attachments, templates, and portable YAML frontmatter.

scripts.lint: eslint src desktop/src scripts test desktop/vite.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json desktop/tsconfig.json desktop/vite.config.ts src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/capabilities/main.json .github && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json desktop/tsconfig.json desktop/vite.config.ts src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/capabilities/main.json .github && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/core.test.mjs test/documents.test.mjs test/workflows.test.mjs test/durability.test.mjs test/canvas.test.mjs test/grants.test.mjs test/plugins.test.mjs test/obsidian-import.test.mjs test/semantic.test.mjs test/sync.test.mjs test/sync-apply.test.mjs test/sync-epoch.test.mjs test/sync-protocol.test.mjs test/sync-relay.test.mjs test/sync-blobs.test.mjs test/sync-blob-transport.test.mjs test/sync-transaction.test.mjs test/keyring.test.mjs test/keyring-create.test.mjs test/keyring-migrate.test.mjs test/keyring-passphrase.test.mjs test/keyring-recovery.test.mjs test/keyring-rekey.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs test/format-conformance.test.mjs test/package.test.mjs test/memory.test.mjs test/memory-ledger.test.mjs test/memory-queue.test.mjs test/rekey-vault.test.mjs
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run desktop:test && npm run desktop:build
scripts.quality:rust: cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib
